class.name: SpinePathConstraint
class.brief_description: Stores the current pose for a path constraint.
class.description: Stores the current pose for a path constraint. A path constraint adjusts the rotation, translation, and scale of the constrained bones so they follow a path attachment. Constraint mix values live on [code]SpinePathConstraintPose[/code]. Read them with [code]get_pose()[/code] or [code]get_applied_pose()[/code]. See [url]http://esotericsoftware.com/spine-path-constraints[/url] in the Spine User Guide.

method.name: get_applied_pose
method.description: Returns the pose last applied to the skeleton by [code]SpineAnimationState.apply()[/code].

method.name: get_bones
method.description: The bones that will be modified by this path constraint. Modifying the array has no effect.

method.name: get_data
method.description: The path constraint's setup pose data.

method.name: get_pose
method.description: Returns the current pose for this path constraint.

method.name: get_slot
method.description: The slot whose path attachment drives this constraint.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns whether this path constraint is active. When inactive, the constraint is not applied.

method.name: set_active
method.description: Sets whether this path constraint is active. When inactive, the constraint is not applied.

method.name: set_slot
method.description: Sets the slot whose path attachment drives this constraint.

method.name: update
method.description: Applies the path constraint so constrained bones follow the target path attachment.
